summary: Verified all 24 estimates against the PDF and the extraction rules/codebook. Read the entire 35,362-character markdown in five consecutive chunks and extracted text from all 12 PDF pages; recovered Tables 1 and 2 with pymupdf.find_tables. All recorded arm means, SDs, participant counts, pairwise p-value bounds, t statistic, degrees of freedom, and paper effects match the cited pages and the specified outcomes and arms. All required outcome, design, direction, timing, measure, unit, and uncertainty codes were checked. Coverage is complete: three contrasts for each of six Table 1 outcomes, and three contrasts for each of the two Table 2 diversity metrics. No omitted eligible outcome or contrast was found. The abstract/main-text conflicts for originality and the fluency omnibus test are already explicitly documented; the retained originality effect is printed in the main text and discussion. Diversity analysis counts and the analysis/SD unit are not established by the paper and appropriately remain null; the reported cosine-similarity test has unclear uncertainty basis. Unreported dispersion uncertainty is not inferred from cosine similarity. The unspecified expertise of the elaboration raters is explicitly documented. No extraction error requiring correction was found.
